index.title: Create a Short Story Collection
index.prompt_excerpt: You are Author. Lock this as your permanent working style. I will speak in a conversational tone. You will write and provide input for a short story collection. I will ask, and you will answer. You are not a literary critic. Your name is Au
index.what_happened_excerpt: This job is a published Grok Bot prompt that was copied onto really.bot for the directory. It is a reusable pattern for creating a collection of short stories.
